articles.title: On-Chip Monitors Detect Bit-Flip Attacks in AI Accelerators (UF, UT Dallas, RPI)
articles.summary: Researchers at the University of Florida, University of Texas at Dallas , and Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute published a technical paper titled “BARE-AI: Bit-Flip Attack Resilience in AI Hardware through Built-in Performance Monitors.” Abstract Excerpt: “Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) are integral to many safety critical systems, yet they remain highly vulnerable to bit-flip attacks (BFAs), where a few memory level perturbations can drastically degrade accuracy. Existing defenses incur significant hardware overhead, depend on retraining, or fail against targeted flips. We propose BARE-AI, a runtime framework that detects, localizes, and mitigates BFAs during AI inference.” Find the technical paper here . October 2026. Rahaman, Habibur, Swastik Bhattacharya, Sanjay Das, Kanad Basu, and Swaru

articles.title: Google is killing Find Hub on Googlebooks, but why?
articles.summary: Credit: Rita El Khoury / Android Authority TL;DR Google Play Services v26.40 disables Find Hub installation and removes its capabilities on Googlebooks. Reddit users recently reported problems with Find Hub on Googlebooks, including being unable to locate their laptops. It’s unclear whether Google is rolling back an unfinished feature or changing its plans for device tracking on Googlebooks. It looks like Google is removing Find Hub support from Googlebook laptops, but the company hasn’t explained why. The latest Google Play Services changelog , dated October 12, says the update disables installation of the Find Hub app and removes Find Hub capabilities from Googlebooks.

articles.summary: Counterpoint Research (CR) has just published its report regarding the global smartphone market for the third quarter of the year (July to September). And it was a terrible one. Shipments dropped 20% compared to Q3 2025. The only winners in terms of growing their market shares were Samsung and Apple. Samsung led the pack with a 23% market share (compared to 19% in the year-ago quarter), while Apple was a close second with 22% (up from 18% in Q3 2025). They were followed by Xiaomi with 10% of the pie (down from 14%), Oppo with 9% (down from 12%), and vivo with 8% (down from 9%). CR...

articles.title: Announcing AWS Lambda Web Functions
articles.summary: Today, we’re announcing AWS Lambda Web Functions , a new form factor that lets you run standard HTTP web applications on Lambda without rewriting your code into an event handler. You can take a standard port-listening server built with Express, Hono, Fastify, Next.js, or any Node.js framework, deploy it with a single command, and Lambda automatically handles scaling, multi-region distribution, and active CPU billing. No adapters, no infrastructure to manage, and no framework lock-in. With this launch, AWS Lambda now offers three distinct form factors, each built on the same Firecracker isolation technology and designed for a different programming model. articles.summary: From its inception, Azure Maia has been built around a single architectural philosophy: optimize the entire system for LLM inference so that every watt and every dollar delivers more intelligence. Now in its third generation , Maia 300 is the fullest expression of that philosophy. Maia 300 is built as a complete system, with software, silicon, physical rack infrastructure, networking, and datacenters co-designed to operate as a single platform to meet the demands of cloud-scale agentic inference. articles.title: 39-year-old unvaccinated woman becomes 6th measles death in Pennsylvania
articles.summary: A 39-year-old unvaccinated woman in Franklin County, Pennsylvania, has become the sixth person to die of the highly infectious virus amid a state outbreak that has stricken over a thousand people since it began in April. The woman died on Saturday, October 10. She had several underlying health conditions and had recently tested positive for measles, according to an advisory posted on social media by Franklin County Coroner Jordan Conner. The advisory noted that the woman's death meets the definition of a measles death set by the state's health department. In an emailed statement to The Washington Post , the coroner's office said the primary cause of death was listed as "probable acute cardiac event due to possible complications of the measles." Read full article Comments

articles.title: 日本量販連鎖Mr Max、超商Lawson、卡拉OK業者資料外洩
articles.summary:
日本折扣量販連鎖Mr Max、便利超商LAWSON及經營卡拉OK的日本娛樂業者第一興商於上周分別公告資料外洩，分別外洩數百萬客戶資訊。
第一興商公告接獲承包商日本古倫美亞（Nippon Columbia）通知客戶資料外洩事件。起因在一名員工PC在10月1日至10月2日間遭惡意程式感染，導致PC儲存的第一興商客戶資料可能外洩。
該公司公告尚未確認資料已遭到濫用，但表示可能外洩的客戶資料包括8,724,000件註冊會員或預約的顧客資訊，資料類型涵括姓名（註冊姓名）、性別、出生日期、電子郵件地址及電話號碼。

articles.title: AMD推Agentic AI機櫃架構Helion，以CPU、GPU彈性配置鎖定不同Agent工作負載
articles.summary: 過去生成式AI基礎架構主要圍繞大型語言模型（LLM）推論，GPU成為AI資料中心建置的重心。但是，隨著企業開始部署能夠自主規畫任務、呼叫工具及串接企業系統的AI Agent，資料中心需要處理的不再只有模型推論，而是增加了Agent執行、工作流程協調、程式執行及多Agent協作等工作，也使CPU重新成為Agent時代的重要運算資源。看準這方面的需求，AMD在周一發表Agentic AI機櫃參考架構（Rack Reference Design）Helion，透過可彈性配置CPU與GPU的開放式架構，以因應不同類型Agent工作負載的需求。

articles.title: 企業數位大小章搬上手機！行動工商憑證如何改變驗證、簽章與授權管理
articles.summary:
今年5月18日，經濟部推出了行動工商憑證，讓企業不必再依賴實體晶片卡與讀卡機，就能透過手機完成身分驗證及數位簽章。行動工商憑證不只是改變使用方式，更將傳統分散在各應用系統的憑證查驗，轉為集中驗證架構，並支援依網站及期限設定行動附卡授權，讓企業更容易管理數位身分與憑證使用權限。
經濟部商業發展署資訊室主任丁珕日前也在2026數位政府高峰會上揭露了打造行動工商憑證背後的歷程。目前超過190套公共服務系統，支援實體和行動工商憑證，像是公司資料變更登記、電子發票管理、員工勞健保申報、營業稅申報等，企業可透過手機完成身分驗證，辦理相關線上業務。

articles.title: 逾1.6萬個Supabase資料庫暴露於公開網路，恐洩漏敏感資料
articles.summary: 資安業者UpGuard於10月1日發布報告，指出該公司掃描約30萬個使用Supabase資料庫的網域後，發現16,326個資料庫存在設定錯誤，資料表可被公開讀取。Supabase是提供託管PostgreSQL資料庫及後端服務的平臺，常用於為網站與行動應用程式提供後端支援，而UpGuard發現的逾1.6萬個暴露Supabase資料庫中，超過一半含有個人識別資訊，部分還包含明文密碼、身分驗證權杖及一次性密碼（OTP），少數資料表則疑似含信用卡資料。

articles.title: 政府推動主權AI，必須在第一天就內建AI治理
articles.summary:
政府開始大規模投入人工智慧，真正需要回答的問題，已經不只是「AI能不能做」，而是「政府能不能掌握AI」。當AI進入公共服務、行政決策、國家安全與關鍵基礎設施，政府面對的不只是模型效能，還包括資料放在哪裡、誰有權使用、模型由誰掌控、運算環境是否可信，以及AI判斷錯誤時，誰能追溯、誰要負責。
這正是主權AI受到各國政府重視的原因。
臺灣戴爾科技集團技術副總經理李百飛認為，政府推動AI不能把治理當成上線前的最後一道檢查，而應從第一天就放進AI治理。若等到系統完成、資料進入模型後，才回頭補資料權限、資安控管、稽核與合規要求，原本可以快速落地的AI專案，往往得重新調整。他直言，「治理內建」與「事後補治理」的差別，直接影響AI能不能走出試點。

articles.summary: 企業因應未來量子電腦對傳統密碼學的威脅，除了需要升級既有系統、導入抗量子密碼學演算法，也必須讓相關人員具備部署及維護新密碼學機制所需的知識。澳洲政府情報與資安機構澳洲通訊局（ASD）公布後量子密碼學（Post-Quantum Cryptography，PQC）轉型系列的第五階段建議，將重點放在跨部門溝通、教育訓練及長期維護，強調企業不能將PQC轉型視為一次性的系統升級工作。

articles.title: Python 3.15預設用UTF-8編碼，並新增延遲匯入機制
articles.summary:
Python開發團隊發布Python 3.15，預設採用UTF-8文字編碼，減少程式在不同作業系統讀寫文字時的差異，並新增延遲匯入機制，讓指定模組等到實際使用時才載入，以縮短程式啟動時間。新版也改進實驗性編譯器及自由執行緒版本的擴充模組支援。
過去Python程式讀寫文字檔時，如果沒有指定編碼，可能依作業系統及語言設定採用不同方式，導致同一份檔案在不同臺電腦可能出現亂碼或讀取錯誤。Python 3.15改以UTF-8處理未指定編碼的文字資料，已明確設定編碼的程式則不受影響。

articles.title: 為何FHIR Box有望突破臺灣智慧醫療困境？衛福部資訊處揭共通平臺布局
articles.summary:
在臺灣，一家醫院做好的AI，另一家醫院卻難以直接使用。這是因為，各家醫院長年來各自開發醫療資訊系統（HIS），要使用另一家醫院開發的AI，往往得重新整理資料、串接系統，甚至再開發一次才能用，耗時又耗力。
衛福部資訊處處長李建璋10月初在臺灣醫院資訊主管會議上，從作業系統（OS）的發展談起，說明臺灣醫療IT如何走出這個困境。這幾年，衛福部推動次世代數位醫療平臺計畫，從統一資料標準、開發轉換工具，到驗證跨院病歷互通，今年再推動FHIR Box，要在既有HIS之上建立共通環境，讓醫院更容易使用其他團隊開發的應用、形成生態系。

articles.title: Apple TV 4K offers Google TV users a more powerful, privacy-focused alternative (for a price)
articles.summary: TL;DR Apple announces the Apple TV 4K with an A19 chip. It’s pricey at $299, but that cost might be inevitable in a chip-shortage world. articles.summary: Earlier this month, Google announced plans to limit access to its newer AI models to those who don’t subscribe to its AI services or pay for the base AI Plus tier. The latter, a $4.99/month demand, will now grant users access only to the Flash and Flash Lite models, putting Pro options out of reach. Free users will no longer be able to access newer Gemini models while AI Pro and Ultra subscribers remain unaffected. The change took effect this past Friday, and it’s understandable that some paying netizens feel this is a bit of a rug pull. Prior to the announcement, Plus subscribers could freely access Pro models allowing for more complex query crunching. This is no longer the case.

Google is also adding post-quantum cryptography to Meet calls to protect them against potential future threats from quantum computers. Google Meet is getting two new features that could make work calls more productive and secure. The platform is introducing automated post-meeting tasks powered by Gemini and Workspace Studio, alongside stronger encryption designed to protect calls against potential future threats from quantum computers.

articles.title: Googlebooks can’t catch a break: Some models don’t have HDR support, but Google is on it
articles.summary: TL;DR Some Reddit users have reported that their Googlebooks don’t support HDR video playback. The problem seems to affect the HP and Dell Googlebooks, although we have no problem with our ASUS model. A Google employee confirmed that some models didn’t have HDR support, but added that the feature would eventually come to all Googlebooks. Googlebooks have had a somewhat rocky launch, owing to device pairing issues and other problems. However, some users have now reported that their new laptops don’t support HDR video playback. A few Reddit users have confirmed that none of the videos they watched on their Googlebooks had HDR support. One user specifically noted that they weren’t seeing HDR badges on YouTube videos.

articles.title: AI labs are buying data from dead startups to train their models
articles.summary: When Keelan Miskell began winding down his crypto startup this year, he didn’t think its data was worth much: the users were anonymous, the company just a few years old. But he’s since turned the firm’s digital archives into real money. He’s netted roughly $25,000 for his code base and a still-pending amount (likely around $15,000) for the workspace data in Google, Notion, Figma, and Slack. “At least all that stuff we were doing for two and a half years is worth something to someone somewhere,” he says. The sale was brokered by a company called SimpleClosure, part of a new growth sector in tech: businesses catering to dying startups. articles.summary: Some numbers are hard to picture until you sit with them for a moment. Last week we published the Prime Day 2026 metrics, and the one that stuck with me is 2.3 quadrillion: the daily requests Amazon ElastiCache peaked at during the event. Prime Day ran back in June, so this post always lands as a retrospective, and that gap is part of what makes it worth reading. By the time the numbers reach you, the only evidence that any of it happened is that nothing went wrong. The rest of the week pulled in a different direction: smaller, cheaper, and more constrained. articles.title: Anthropic’s red team ran AI on 15 cheap TV boxes. Then the math got unsettling.
articles.summary: For roughly $825, Anthropic’s Frontier Red Team built a cluster of 15 off-brand Android TV boxes that runs an AI model at 0.39 tokens per second, painfully slow for a chatbot but fine for software with nowhere to be and nobody waiting on it. That experiment anchors new research from Anthropic researchers William Zhou and Daniel Freeman , published Monday, suggesting small open-weight models may be only months away from copying themselves across cheap, internet-connected hardware without relying on a datacenter. The researchers haven’t built an AI worm that can spread across the public internet on its own, and their experiments took place inside controlled environments with shortcuts that made replication easier. But the results suggest several of the remaining technical barrier

articles.title: Workday is using TypeSafe’s Jev to build user interfaces on the fly
articles.summary: Workday on Tuesday made Sana, its AI assistant, the new home screen for its HR, finance, and IT software. If you’re not an HR pro, that may not be all that exciting for you, but the way the team built this is maybe one of the most interesting use cases of Jev, TypeSafe’s decision model . Workday is building the user interface on the fly — and all of that is managed by Jev. In a demo during a press briefing ahead of the announcement, a question about a paycheck brought up a card with the amount hidden behind a click, for example, while a request for time off produced a date picker, with Sana filling in the rest of the form. Sana, which Workday bought for $1.1 billion last year, is available now, and admins can roll it out to their users without making it the default. Credi

articles.title: The X Subscription bundles Cursor with Grok and X Premium. But Claude now costs extra.
articles.summary: Elon Musk’s mission to unify his sprawling tech empire continues apace, with the news that X, Grok, and Cursor are being bundled together as a single plan dubbed The X Subscription . Taking to X late on Monday, SpaceXAI announced the new pricing structure. It has five tiers, from free up to $200 per month, with the cheapest paid option costing $8. Paid tiers share a single pool of Grok-model usage across eligible products, and existing Cursor subscribers can keep their current plans — for now, at least. However, arguably the bigger news for developers is the change to how Cursor charges for AI models. While the new subscriptions offer more included coding usage with Grok, customers who prefer competing models from the likes of Anthropic and OpenAI will face additional charges.

Plus, Apple releases a new line of smart home devices including its HomeView Hub, the centerpiece of its push to challenge Amazon and Google in that space. And, Meta releases a new AI model which it says has "frontier capabilities" as it vies to take on OpenAI and Anthropic. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: SambaNova CEO: AI’s Next Phase Is About Efficiency
articles.summary: SambaNova CEO Rodrigo Liang says the AI infrastructure boom is entering a new phase focused increasingly on inference, efficiency and return on investment. As the company closes its Series F with new strategic investors, Liang discusses why enterprises including JPMorgan are running AI infrastructure behind their own firewalls and why frontier models and private AI systems can coexist. He joins Bloomberg's Dani Burger from the CAIS Summit in Beverly Hills, live on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: SpaceX IPO Helps Fuel $100 Billion Space Boom
articles.summary: Investment in the space economy could top $100 billion this year for the first time according to analysis from investment firm Space Capital, as SpaceX’s blockbuster IPO, rising defense demand and the need for new infrastructure draw more capital into the sector. Bloomberg’s Loren Grush discusses how SpaceX is reshaping investment well beyond its own business with Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Meta’s Muse Wonder Takes Aim at OpenAI, Anthropic
articles.summary: Meta says its new Muse Wonder model has frontier-level capabilities, marking a major milestone in the company’s AI overhaul under chief AI officer Alexandr Wang. Bloomberg’s Riley Griffin spoke to him, and joins to discuss how Meta is positioning the model against rivals including OpenAI and Anthropic and how it was purpose-built to power the company’s Muse personal AI assistant. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: The Paris Auto Show is full of interesting cars Americans can’t have
articles.summary: Perhaps the days when auto shows debuted new models aren’t entirely over. The big trade shows for cars were a gateway drug for many, expos where you could see the newest models of today and the concepts of tomorrow. But automakers increasingly got tired of sharing the spotlight with each other. New reveals moved offsite to events the night or even the week before the show itself. One by one, brands pulled out of auto show after auto show until there was little left to see . And then the pandemic hit. But the news out of Paris, where its auto show held media day yesterday, seems like we stepped back into a time when automakers would debut new cars aplenty. articles.title: Apple’s first smart display is the 7-inch HomeView for $299
articles.summary: Apple opened preorders for the HomeView smart home hub today. The HomeView is a 7-inch smart display and speaker that aims to be a central access point for up to six members of a family to access and control Apple’s ecosystem of devices, apps, and the Siri generative AI chatbot. Users can speak to HomeView to control smart home devices, such as, for example, telling Siri to close the smart blinds or activate smart locks. HomeView can also show a livestream for up to nine video feeds simultaneously. Read full article Comments

articles.title: High-speed video reveals how honey bee stingers pump venom
articles.summary: Credit: Ramirez-Esquivel et al 202 Credit: Ramirez-Esquivel et al 202 Honey bees are known to leave their stingers embedded in tender flesh once they sting you and fly away. Scientists have now determined that the stinger is able to continue pumping venom into its unfortunate victim even after the bee flies away, thanks to a unique double-piston pump-like mechanism, according to a new paper published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences. Different species have evolved different mechanisms for delivering venom, which involves piercing the skin and then pumping venom from a gland or reservoir. articles.title: Ledger硬體加密貨幣錢包設備驚傳被植入隱藏晶片，遭竊資產超過一億美元
articles.summary: 法國硬體加密貨幣錢包設備Ledger驚傳用戶的資產遭不明原因洗劫一空，引起全球高度關注。10月9日Ledger定調是經銷商CryptoBillis銷售的設備有問題並著手調查，呼籲近3個月從該經銷商購置硬體錢包的客戶，應將資產移轉到新錢包，並更換通關密語（seed）。此起事故迄今有超過300個錢包的資產遭竊，損失超過1億美元。而這些錢包遭竊的原因，竟是裝置被植入額外的元件，一旦用戶啟用，就會將通關密語傳送給攻擊者。

articles.title: SQLite 3.54命令列新增磁碟空間分析指令，舊分析工具將退場
articles.summary: 資料庫SQLite開發團隊發布3.54.0版，將資料庫磁碟空間分析功能整合進命令列，開發者可直接查看資料表與索引占用多少磁碟空間，不必另外執行分析工具。新版也改善查詢效率，官方測試顯示效能約提升4%，並停止支援Windows XP及Windows CE等舊系統。

articles.title: Let's Encrypt明年將TLS憑證效期從90天縮至64天，2028年再降至45天，憑證續期自動化更顯重要
articles.summary: 公開TLS憑證效期近年持續朝縮短方向發展，Let's Encrypt於10月7日宣布，自2027年2月10日起，預設TLS憑證效期將由目前的90天縮短為64天，後續還將進一步縮短。這項漸進式調整，主要是為了縮短金鑰外洩或憑證誤簽後的風險暴露時間。

articles.title: LINE官方帳號將內建AI代理平台，先提供3款店家AI代理角色，也將支援MCP協定
articles.summary:
LINE今天在年度記者會宣布，LINE官方帳號服務推出AI代理平台，可以讓店家打造自己的商家AI代理，先推出三款AI代理角色，包括預約、銷售和客服Agent，目前和品牌合作展開POC驗證，2027年第一季正式推出，目前還沒公布收費方案。AI代理先開放串接LINE技術合作夥伴，也計畫支援MCP協定。目前還沒公布收費模式。
LINE官方帳號早期以行銷推廣為主，2019年全面開放API串接，2023年推出LINE MINI App，去年則推出了AI商務對話功能。目前，LINE官方帳號數量已經成長到360萬個帳號，超過8成LINE用戶使用過店家的官方帳號服務。

articles.title: 德國政府公布PQC遷移指引，高風險系統最晚2030年完成轉換、整體遷移目標2035年
articles.summary: 德國政府正式提出後量子密碼學（Post-Quantum Cryptography，PQC）的國家遷移時程與方向。10月12日，德國聯邦內政部（BMI）、數位化與國家現代化部（BMDS）及聯邦資訊安全辦公室（BSI）共同公布PQC遷移指引，承接歐盟2025年發布的PQC轉型路線圖，進一步訂出德國國內的準備工作與遷移時程。
